result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue with overlapping text in a restaurant entry, which breaks content readability.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' entry in the 'Popular right now' section, the supporting text elements (delivery time '25-30', 'delivery', 'Ramen') are overlapping each other, making the content unreadable and visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the spacing and layout of the text elements for this restaurant card to ensure the delivery time, delivery fee status, and cuisine label are properly aligned and not overlapping, restoring readability.
